purpose: Bounded exploratory student-state correction pilot; no final test data used.
warm_start: Atomic preparation snapshot of mc-ppo-v3/best.npz; actual hash recorded by preparation
preconditions: Exact full-strength engine-control replay in both seats
Four-game training pipeline with two-pair validation completes
allocation: Main PPO keeps two workers; this pilot replaces the completed capacity validation worker; total long-job workers <= 3.
promotion: Consider further training only if selected pilot score exceeds concurrent selected main PPO and paired 95% bootstrap lower bound of difference is positive; otherwise retain main PPO.
fallback: Controller resumes original main/capacity choice on 3 workers after pilot, pending manual comparison. No automatic student promotion.
